name: writing-caret
title: Writing caret
author: Sanjay Kumar <https://github.com/luv-jeri>
description: A quiet writing mark with a short, deliberate blink sequence.

props.name: blinkCount
props.description: At most six cycles; zero leaves a still mark.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds per cycle. Total motion is bounded to six seconds.
